world.title: A Florida couple blamed state stormwater work for cracks, toxic mould and a hole that let a snake into their daughter's bedroom; November 25 federal appeals judges revived their request for emergency
world.summary: A Florida couple has reported structural cracks, toxic mould, and a hole that allowed a snake into their daughter's bedroom, attributing these issues to state stormwater work. On November 25, a federal appeals court revived their request for emergency protection, overturning a lower court's decision. This ruling provides the couple another opportunity to pursue their claims.

world.title: Ukraine's Strike in Benghazi Threatens the Deal That Keeps Libya at Peace
world.summary: Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship in Benghazi on November 22 has escalated tensions in Libya, jeopardizing the country's fragile peace. Concerns are rising over potential Russian retaliation, which could lead to a resurgence of civil conflict. This incident occurs as Libya seeks to attract foreign oil investments at an energy summit, aiming to increase its production capacity.

world.title: US Storm Disrupts Thanksgiving, Cancels 400 Flights, Leaves 724,000 Without Power
world.summary: A powerful storm disrupted Thanksgiving in the U.S., causing nearly 400 flight cancellations and over 2,000 delays, primarily in the East, according to FlightAware. The storm, known as a "Nor-easter," resulted in heavy rain and strong winds, leading to the postponement of New York's Macy's parade for the first time in its 100-year history. Over 724,000 people lost power.

business.title: A Rs 2.28 lakh cr market by 2030: 2 cash-rich stocks riding India’s construction equipment boom
business.summary: India's ₹11,000 crore equipment manufacturing scheme aims to boost domestic production and reduce reliance on imports, potentially creating a ₹2.28 lakh crore market by 2030. Two leading companies are expanding their capacity and developing specialized products to capitalize on this growth. The initiative is expected to reshape the competitive landscape in the construction equipment sector significantly.

business.title: WhatsApp could soon introduce a travel eSIM feature
business.summary: WhatsApp is developing a travel eSIM feature that will enable users to search for destinations and manage eSIMs directly within the app. This feature will allow users to discover, purchase, and install eSIMs for their travel needs. The functionality was recently identified in the latest version of WhatsApp for Android, indicating ongoing enhancements to the app's capabilities.

business.title: The unravelling of Flipkart’s Kalyan Krishnamurthy-slow and then fast
business.summary: Flipkart announced the unexpected departure of CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy after over 11 years with the company. While the official press release did not provide a reason for his exit, it has led to speculation about underlying issues within the Walmart-owned firm. This move comes amid ongoing challenges faced by the company in the competitive e-commerce landscape.

technology.title: Quordle hints and answers for Friday, November 27 (game #1768)
technology.summary: Quordle provides daily puzzles, with a new game released at midnight in each time zone. Players can access hints and answers for the current game, as well as past solutions. The article mentions that Future and its partners may earn a commission through links provided. Players seeking assistance can find clues and solutions for Quordle game #1768.

technology.title: As GTA 6 PC port projects make significant progress, its first unofficial mod menu and launcher have surfaced
technology.summary: Modders are advancing in creating unofficial PC ports of GTA 6, despite Take-Two's efforts to halt these projects. The first unofficial mod menu and launcher for the game have emerged, indicating significant progress in the modding community. Rockstar Games has not yet announced an official PC version, but the development continues to gain momentum among enthusiasts.

technology.title: Alienware Makes Some of the Best OLED Gaming Monitors Around and They're All on Sale for Black Friday
technology.summary: Alienware is offering discounts on its OLED gaming monitors for Black Friday, known for their high quality and performance. These monitors come with a three-year warranty that covers OLED burn-in, providing added assurance for users. The 39" Alienware 5K OLED monitor is highlighted as a top choice among gaming displays, showcasing the brand's commitment to excellence in gaming technology.

sports.title: Pant Sneaks Into Christchurch Club Match, Blasts 54
sports.summary: Rishabh Pant made a surprise appearance at a Christchurch club match under the alias 'Stan Stan', scoring 54 runs off 21 balls. His participation came after a chance encounter, bringing excitement to local players ahead of India's second Test. Pant, dressed in a purple tracksuit, delighted the crowd with his performance, showcasing his batting skills in an informal setting.

sports.title: 'Hard to believe': Ex-India cricketer questions Mohammed Siraj's continued omission from playing XI
sports.summary: Former India cricketer Mohammed Kaif has expressed disbelief over the exclusion of pacer Mohammed Siraj from the playing XI for the second Test against New Zealand. Kaif criticized the team management's decision, emphasizing that Siraj should be a key player in the lineup. His comments highlight ongoing discussions regarding team selection and player performance in international cricket.

sports.title: Bayern’s injury excuses cannot hide a disappointing loss to LOSC Lille
sports.summary: Bayern Munich suffered a disappointing 2-1 defeat to LOSC Lille in the Champions League, missing a crucial opportunity for three points. The team's midfielder highlighted a lackluster second-half performance as a key factor in the loss. Despite injury challenges, Bayern's inability to capitalize on chances ultimately led to their downfall in the match.

health.title: Can AI diagnose breast cancer faster? A major trial aims to find out
health.summary: Britain's National Health Service has initiated a significant trial, named the EDITH study, to evaluate whether artificial intelligence can enhance early breast cancer diagnosis. The study aims to involve 660,000 women across England and Scotland. Researchers will assess AI's effectiveness in identifying cancer earlier than traditional methods, potentially improving outcomes for patients through timely detection and intervention.

health.title: Strand Life eyes market share in multi-cancer early detection
health.summary: Strand Life Sciences, supported by Reliance Industries, aims to enhance its CancerSpot screening test capabilities. The company plans to reduce testing costs to below ₹10,000 within two years. Reliance's objective is to make advanced diagnostics more accessible in India, necessitating innovation and the development of local genomic technologies and reagents to achieve this goal.

health.title: Hetero begins phased shipments of generic lenacapavir to Africa for HIV prevention
health.summary: Hetero, a pharmaceutical company based in Hyderabad, has started phased shipments of generic injectable lenacapavir to Africa for HIV prevention. The initial supply consists of 300,000 vials, targeting Zambia, Uganda, and Zimbabwe. This initiative aims to enhance access to HIV prevention methods in these countries, contributing to global efforts in combating the HIV epidemic.

science.title: Extreme weather in India and China shared a hidden atmospheric connection
science.summary: A new analysis reveals a connection between extreme weather events in India and southern China, attributing India's heat wave and China's transition from flooding to humid heat to the same high-pressure system. Conducted by Meng Gao from Hong Kong Baptist University, the study highlights how atmospheric circulation can influence weather patterns across regions, impacting climate conditions significantly.

science.title: New Astronomical Evidence Raises Possibility of a Giant Planet Beyond Neptune
science.summary: Astronomers have detected unusual orbital patterns among distant objects in the outer Solar System, suggesting the potential existence of an undiscovered giant planet beyond Neptune. This hypothetical object has been provisionally named “Planet X2,” differentiating it from the previously proposed Planet Nine. Further research is needed to confirm its existence and understand its implications for the Solar System's structure.

science.title: Progress MS-36 Docks With Space Station
science.summary: The Progress MS-36 cargo spacecraft successfully docked with the International Space Station on November 26, 2026, after launching from Baikonur on November 24. It delivered over 2.4 tons of supplies, including fuel, oxygen, and water, as well as the Teledroid robot control system. This mission supports ongoing operations and research aboard the Russian segment of the space station.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 27, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 27, 2026, Pisces individuals are encouraged to focus on learning and self-care. The horoscope emphasizes the importance of balancing giving to others with giving to oneself. This period calls for reflection on how to support both personal needs and the needs of others, suggesting that self-care is equally important as helping those around you.

entertainment.title: Pisces Horoscope Today: November 27, 2026
entertainment.summary: Today, November 27, 2026, Pisces individuals are encouraged to focus on both giving to others and nurturing themselves. The horoscope suggests a period of learning and relearning, emphasizing the importance of balance in personal relationships. Reflect on ways to support both your own needs and those of others, ensuring a harmonious approach to interactions during this time.

entertainment.summary: On November 27, 2026, Libras are advised to reconsider their current mindset and actions. While there are numerous tasks at hand, it's important to avoid following the crowd blindly. This period encourages self-reflection and the pursuit of individuality. Embracing personal insights may lead to positive changes, urging Libras to break free from conformity and explore new paths.
